question: The 'East-West' corridor connects which of the following cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Silchar and Porbandar. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **'East-West'** corridor is a major highway project undertaken by the Indian government to connect the** eastern and western regions** of the country.
 
• It is also known as **National Highway 27 (NH-27).**
 
• The corridor starts from **Porbandar in Gujarat **and ends at **Silchar in Assam,** covering a distance of around **3,400 km.**
 
• It passes through several major cities and towns, including** Ahmedabad, Udaipur, Ajmer, Jaipur, Agra, Kanpur, Guwahati, and Shillong.**
 
• The 'East-West' corridor is an important infrastructure project that aims to** promote economic growth and development** in the regions it connects.
 
• It is expected to **improve connectivity, reduce travel time,** and boost **trade and commerce.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Itanagar** is the **capital city** of **Arunachal Pradesh**, located in the **northeastern region** of India, while **Dwarka** is a city in** Gujarat,** located in the western region of India.

 
 
• These two cities are** not connected** by the 'East-West' corridor.
 
 
 
• While both** Guwahati and Gandhinagar **are connected by** NH-27**, they are not the endpoints of the 'East-West' corridor.
 
 
• Moreover, Gandhinagar is **not even l**ocated on the eastern or western coast of India.
 
 
 
• While **Shillong** is located on** NH-27** and is connected to several other cities on the corridor, **Kandla** is a **port town** in **Gujarat** that is not directly connected to the 'East-West' corridor.
